findings.problem: Sparse spill: the final page of the study carries only the four-line compact rights colophon (439 characters, no running head or folio) on an otherwise blank page, after References and the revision timestamp closed on page 31. The synthesis and homily keep the same colophon on their final content pages, so the spill is a pagination accident of the study, not the design.
findings.required_result: If acted on, pull the rights colophon back onto page 31 with the terminal References and revision timestamp (for example by a small reduction in the References block's spacing or a page-break hint at the content boundary), or leave it as a deliberate plain colophon page; the page must not remain a four-line orphan if the surrounding pages are next touched.

summary: Full-page visual review of the three sealed artifacts of liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints (provider claude): study build/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints.pdf (32 pages, sha256 3d6f91d0b5acdab1bbd105f4fa6e6943783649a34f2a82dc1ca60604d6ebd7c6), synthesis f02-all-saints-synthesis.pdf (12 pages, sha256 7ad32f84edbfd16bdc9414f341b3f9ec1e4f588d9296341562fc19a3cdc23cf8), homily f02-all-saints-homily.pdf (4 pages, sha256 792836934fc5f992722a39cf49d1556bc4da94e86a0b3e77ad54b5be2f1b8cfa). All REVIEW_INPUTS seals (3 PDFs, 2 pagination aux files, 28 render inputs) verified by sha256sum against the checkout. Inspected the contact sheets of all 48 pages, full-size rasters of 16 pages including every layout-critical page (study 1-6, 18, 26-27, 31-32; synthesis 1-2, 12; homily 3-4), per-page pdftotext extraction of every page, pdffonts, and all three build logs. Baseline confirmed: Latin Modern throughout (all fonts embedded subsets, no non-LM fonts), 11pt article with 0.75in margins per src/common/preamble.tex, monochrome, legible type and measure, consistent running heads and folios (colophon pages plain by consistent design), no overfull/underfull/undefined-reference warnings in any log. Study: 32 pages within 20-50; descriptive keyed lane headings; four-senses blocks render with Literal/Allegorical/Moral/Anagogical items; comparison table fits; terminal apparatus and compact rights colophon present. Synthesis: 12 pages within 10-12; physical page 1 carries the complete propers map (all appointed elements, commemorations and the unsettled Preface identified as options) followed immediately by exactly four sense rows; page 2 carries Scriptural Date and Location alone in the orientation-v2 Passage/Occurrence-and-place/Date table with composition, setting, attribution and event kept distinct and uncertainty retained; pages 3-4 Themes and Movement; developed commentary begins page 5; all confirmed on the rendered pages and matching the settled zref markers in the sealed aux. Passage lookup performed at normal reading size: 'Gospel: Matthew 5:1-12' pairs to the event on the unnamed mountain after the Galilee circuit with date 'Date unresolved', and 'Offertory: Wisdom 3:1-3' to the disputed Ptolemy IV Philopator / Ptolemy VII Physcon composition dates, each pairing readable within its row without traversing another column. Homily: full-width title, two-column speech of about 1,445 words (11.1-12.0 minutes, matching the note), no apparatus intruding into the speech, full-width terminal Note on Sources and Delivery and References. No blocking defect remains; one advisory recorded. Meaningful limits: I judged layout and usability, not the truth of content claims, which upstream content reviews own.
